# VF Psychology

> Online psychology practice of Valeria Verhaar Flores, MSc — a clinical
> psychologist specialising in children and adolescents. Sessions in English
> and Spanish (Dutch for children), delivered fully online. Founded February
> 2020. A free 10-minute introductory call can be booked via the contact form.

Practice details:
- Psychologist: Valeria Verhaar Flores, MSc (clinical psychologist)
- Languages: English and Spanish; Dutch for children
- Format: online sessions, worldwide
- Free intake: 10-minute introductory call, booked through the contact form
- Fees: discussed during the free call; no insurance billing
- E-mail: vf.psychology@gmail.com
- Phone: 06-38136116 (+31 6 38136116)
- KvK 77411528 · SPS-NIP 245010 · SKJ 160029073

## Services
- [Individual therapy](https://vf-psychology.nl/individual-therapy.html): therapy for adults — anxiety, stress, self-esteem, life transitions
- [Child psychology](https://vf-psychology.nl/child-psychology.html): support for children and adolescents
- [Autism therapy](https://vf-psychology.nl/autism-therapy.html): assessment and support around autism
- [Couple counseling](https://vf-psychology.nl/couple-counseling.html): support for couples and relationships
- [Expat support](https://vf-psychology.nl/expat-support.html): adjustment, identity and belonging for internationals
- [Parent guidance](https://vf-psychology.nl/parent-guidance.html): coaching and guidance for parents
- [Pregnancy, postpartum & beyond](https://vf-psychology.nl/pregnancy-postpartum.html): perinatal and postpartum mental health
